title: show the rules
name: Show the rules
rule: Show the Rules — requirements visible the whole time the field is selected (not a hidden link; not inside the placeholder).

citation.source: NN/g — Password Creation: 3 Ways To Make It Easier

pass_when: While the password-creation field is selected, the requirements stay visible outside the placeholder.
fail_when: Rules only in a hidden link, only in the placeholder, or only after submit.
overview: Password requirements stay visible while the creation field is selected.
apply_when: Password-creation fields that have complexity or format requirements.
not_when: Rules only in a hidden link, placeholder, or after submit.
agent_hint: Keep password rules visible while the creation field is selected, outside placeholders.
description: Show the Rules: password requirements stay visible the whole time the creation field is selected. They must not live only in a hidden link or inside the placeholder. Pass when requirements stay visible outside the placeholder while the field is selected. Fail when rules appear only in a hidden link, only in the placeholder, or only after submit.
do_not_claim: Strength meter (`forms.inputs.password_strength_meter`). Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.inputs.password_strength_meter` + `forms.fields.explain_format_upfront`. Meter already skipped; this row is requirements visible the whole time the field is selected.
